name_th: โบนัสทักษะ

desc_en: In battles between non-player characters in our territory, all heroes in the battle will gain %s lifesteal.

desc_in: Dalam pertempuran antara karakter non-pemain di wilayah kami, semua pahlawan akan mendapat %s lifesteal
desc_ph: Sa mga laban sa pagitan ng mga hindi manlalarong karakter sa aming teritoryo, lahat ng bayani ay magkakaroon ng %s lifesteal.
desc_ma: Dalam pertempuran antara watak bukan pemain di wilayah kami, semua wira akan mendapat %s keupayaan sedut nyawa.

name: Skill Bonus
name_th: โบนัสทักษะ
desc: In battles between non-player characters in this server’s territory, all heroes in the battle will gain %s increased healing rate.
desc_vn: Trong các trận chiến giữa những người không phải là người chơi trong lãnh thổ của máy chủ này, tất cả các anh hùng trong trận chiến đều có %s tỷ lệ hồi máu tăng lên
desc_en: In battles between non-player characters in this server’s territory, all heroes in the battle will gain %s increased healing rate.

desc_in: Dalam pertempuran antara karakter non-pemain di wilayah server ini, semua pahlawan akan memiliki peningkatan tingkat penyembuhan sebesar %s
desc_ph: Sa mga laban sa pagitan ng mga hindi manlalarong karakter sa teritoryo ng server na ito, lahat ng bayani ay magkakaroon ng %s dagdag sa healing rate.
desc_ma: Dalam pertempuran antara watak bukan pemain di wilayah pelayan ini, semua wira akan mendapat %s kadar pemulihan tambahan.

name: Skill Bonus
name_th: โบนัสทักษะ
desc: In battles between non-player characters in our territory, silence resistance is increased by $(4 + skill level * 4)$%.
desc_vn: Trong các trận chiến giữa những người không phải là người chơi trong lãnh thổ của chúng tôi, tăng khả năng kháng nhập âm là $(4+skilllevel*4)$%.
desc_en: In battles between non-player characters in our territory, silence resistance is increased by $(4 + skill level * 4)$%.
desc_th: ในการต่อสู้ระหว่างตัวละครที่ไม่ใช่ผู้เล่นในอาณาเขตของเรา การต้านทานสถานะเงียบเพิ่มขึ้น $(4 + ระดับสกิล * 4)$%
desc_in: Dalam pertempuran antara karakter non-pemain di wilayah kami, resistensi terhadap silence meningkat sebesar $(4 + level skill * 4)$%
desc_ph: Sa mga laban sa pagitan ng mga hindi manlalarong karakter sa aming teritoryo, tataas ang resistance sa silence ng $(4 + antas ng kasanayan * 4)$%
desc_ma: Dalam pertempuran antara watak bukan pemain di wilayah kami, rintangan kepada senyap akan meningkat sebanyak $(4 + tahap kemahiran * 4)$%.

name: Skill Bonus
name_th: โบนัสทักษะ
desc: When any of your heroes are affected by a control effect, there is a $(50 + skill level * 10)$% chance to immediately dispel 1 control effect. This can trigger up to 5 times per game.
desc_vn: Khi bất kỳ anh hùng nào của bạn nhận được hiệu ứng Điều khiển, $(50+cấp độ kỹ năng*10)$% cơ hội ngay lập tức xua tan 1 Hiệu ứng điều khiển, hiệu ứng này chỉ kích hoạt 5 lần trong toàn bộ trò chơi
desc_en: When any of your heroes are affected by a control effect, there is a $(50 + skill level * 10)$% chance to immediately dispel 1 control effect. This can trigger up to 5 times per game.
desc_th: เมื่อฮีโร่ใดๆ ของคุณติดเอฟเฟกต์ควบคุม มีโอกาส $(50 + ระดับสกิล * 10)$% ที่จะลบสถานะควบคุม 1 ครั้งทันที เอฟเฟกต์นี้เกิดได้สูงสุด 5 ครั้งต่อเกม
desc_in: Saat salah satu pahlawanmu terkena efek kontrol, ada peluang $(50 + level skill * 10)$% untuk langsung menghapus 1 efek kontrol. Efek ini hanya aktif hingga 5 kali dalam satu permainan
desc_ph: Kapag ang alinman sa iyong mga bayani ay tinamaan ng control effect, may $(50 + antas ng kasanayan * 10)$% chance na agad maalis ang 1 control effect. Limitado sa 5 beses bawat laro.
desc_ma: Apabila mana-mana wira anda terkena kesan kawalan, terdapat $(50 + tahap kemahiran * 10)$% peluang untuk menghapuskan 1 kesan kawalan serta-merta. Had 5 kali setiap permainan.

name: Skill Bonus
name_th: โบนัสทักษะ
desc: Each attack permanently reduces the target’s healing effect by $(20 + skill level * 3)$% (cannot be dispelled), up to 6 stacks.
desc_vn: Mỗi đòn tấn công làm giảm vĩnh viễn hiệu ứng hồi máu $(20+cấp độ kỹ năng*3)$% của mục tiêu (không thể xua tan), cộng dồn 6 cộng dồn
desc_en: Each attack permanently reduces the target’s healing effect by $(20 + skill level * 3)$% (cannot be dispelled), up to 6 stacks.
desc_th: การโจมตีแต่ละครั้งจะลดการฟื้นฟูของเป้าหมายลงถาวร $(20 + ระดับสกิล * 3)$% (ไม่สามารถลบได้), สะสมได้สูงสุด 6 ชั้น
desc_in: Setiap serangan secara permanen mengurangi efek penyembuhan target sebesar $(20 + level skill * 3)$% (tidak bisa dihapus), hingga 6 tumpukan
desc_ph: Bawat atake ay permanenteng nagpapababa ng healing effect ng target ng $(20 + antas ng kasanayan * 3)$% (hindi matanggal), hanggang 6 stacks.
desc_ma: Setiap serangan mengurangkan kesan penyembuhan sasaran sebanyak $(20 + tahap kemahiran * 3)$% secara kekal (tidak boleh dibuang), sehingga 6 timbunan.

name: Skill Bonus
name_th: โบนัสทักษะ
desc: Gain $(10 + skill level * 2)$% speed for 2 turns, consuming current HP before the turn begins. This effect will not trigger if HP falls below a certain threshold.
desc_vn: Tăng tốc độ lên $(10+cấp độ kỹ năng*2)$% trong 2 lượt, mất HP hiện tại của bạn trước khi lượt bắt đầu và không kích hoạt nếu HP của bạn giảm xuống dưới một giá trị nhất định
desc_en: Gain $(10 + skill level * 2)$% speed for 2 turns, consuming current HP before the turn begins. This effect will not trigger if HP falls below a certain threshold.
desc_th: เพิ่มความเร็ว $(10 + ระดับสกิล * 2)$% เป็นเวลา 2 เทิร์น โดยจะสูญเสีย HP ปัจจุบันก่อนเริ่มเทิร์น เอฟเฟกต์นี้จะไม่ทำงานหาก HP ต่ำกว่าค่าที่กำหนด
desc_in: Tingkatkan kecepatan sebesar $(10 + level skill * 2)$% selama 2 giliran, kehilangan HP saat ini sebelum giliran dimulai. Efek ini tidak akan aktif jika HP di bawah ambang batas tertentu
desc_ph: Makakakuha ng $(10 + antas ng kasanayan * 2)$% speed sa loob ng 2 turn, babawasan ang kasalukuyang HP bago magsimula ang turn. Hindi i-aactivate kung ang HP ay mababa sa isang tiyak na threshold.
desc_ma: Meningkatkan kelajuan sebanyak $(10 + tahap kemahiran * 2)$% selama 2 pusingan, mengorbankan HP semasa sebelum giliran bermula. Tidak diaktifkan jika HP jatuh di bawah ambang tertentu.
